description: Optimizes for stable baseline conditions but performs poorly under deep uncertainty and cascade stress.
Balances baseline efficiency with moderate resilience and cross-scenario viability.
Uses monitoring triggers learning loops and flexible pathways to revise action over time.
Prioritizes severe and irreversible harm reduction under uncertain probabilities.
Sacrifices peak efficiency to preserve buffers redundancy and continuity under disruption.
Strengthens coordination finance workforce accountability legitimacy and learning systems.
Maps interdependencies and reduces single-point failures chokepoints and cross-domain vulnerabilities.
Changes system structure where existing arrangements repeatedly produce unacceptable risk.
